items.title: Mount external drive on linux
items.content_text: Writing this down so I don’t have to remember. Find the drive lsblk -f Look for partition (usually sda1) with FSTYPE ext4, and note its UUID. Create a mount point sudo mkdir -p /mnt/sata Mount it manually to test sudo mount /dev/sda1 /mnt/sata ls...
